title: Code and data for: El Niño and the annual probability of reaching the alert and evacuation levels in the towns of the middle Uruguay River
description: R code, input series and derived tables for an article submitted to Atmósfera. For seven gauges of the Uruguay River in Misiones and Corrientes (Argentina), a Poisson process with a rate that depends on the Niño 3.4 index and a generalised Pareto distribution for flood height give the annual probability of reaching each official alert and evacuation level.
